field.p: Your premium. Annual, on the oldest applicant's age: principal and spouse pay that age group's rates and outpatient is per person at that rate; inpatient has a separate child rate. Dental and optical only with outpatient.
Who can join. From birth (term baby) to 64; members move to J Senior at 65. Children over 18 up to 25 if in school. Medical exam from 50, at the applicant's cost.

Waiting periods. Accidents: none. Illness: 30 days. Pre-existing, chronic, psychiatric, congenital, HIV/AIDS, transplants, maternity, gynaecological, non-accident eye or dental surgery, hernia, tonsils, thyroid and similar: 1 year. Cancer: 2 years.

Co-payments. KES 2,000 per outpatient visit at Nairobi Hospital (main), MP Shah (Parklands), Karen, Aga Khan (Parklands), Gertrude's (Muthaiga) and AAR (Kiambu Rd); KES 1,000 at Mater (main), Avenue (Parklands), Mediheal, Eldoret Hospital, St Luke's (Eldoret), Mombasa Hospital and Premier (Nyali); none elsewhere.
Before treatment. Planned admissions: pre-authorised 48 hours ahead. Abroad: accident and emergency care for 6 weeks a trip, refunded.

Not covered. Cosmetic surgery unless after an accident, alternative treatment, self-injury, alcohol and drugs, war and riots, hazardous sports, weight and hormone treatment, fertility treatment, pandemics beyond the Covid-19 limits, glasses and dental unless bought, and Jubilee's other exclusions.
How to pay. Pay Jubilee directly: M-Pesa Paybill 7195247, a cheque to Jubilee Health Insurance Ltd, or a deposit to its bank account. Keep Jubilee's receipt.

Please note. This is a quotation, not cover: cover starts when Jubilee accepts the application and receives the full premium. Declare all health conditions: an undeclared one can lead to refused claims or cancelled cover. This is a summary; Jubilee's policy document prevails.

field.p: Your premium. Annual, on the oldest applicant's age: principal and spouse pay that age group's rates, as do outpatient and last expense per person; children have their own rates. Dental and optical only with outpatient.
Who can join. From 65, joining up to 79; cover continues for life, subject to annual renewal. Medical exam at the applicant's cost.

Waiting periods. Accidents: none. Illness: 30 days. Pre-existing, chronic, psychiatric, congenital, HIV/AIDS, transplants, maternity, gynaecological, non-accident eye or dental surgery, hernia, tonsils, thyroid and similar: 1 year. Cancer: 2 years.

Co-payments. KES 2,000 per outpatient visit at Nairobi Hospital (main), MP Shah (Parklands), Karen, Aga Khan (Parklands), Gertrude's (Muthaiga) and AAR (Kiambu Rd); KES 1,000 at Mater (main), Avenue (Parklands), Mediheal, Eldoret Hospital, St Luke's (Eldoret), Mombasa Hospital and Premier (Nyali); none elsewhere.
Before treatment. Planned admissions: pre-authorised 48 hours ahead. Abroad: accident and emergency care for 6 weeks a trip, refunded.

Not covered. Cosmetic surgery unless after an accident, alternative treatment, self-injury, alcohol and drugs, war and riots, hazardous sports, weight and hormone treatment, pandemics beyond the Covid-19 limits, glasses and dental unless bought, and Jubilee's other exclusions.
How to pay. Pay Jubilee directly: M-Pesa Paybill 7195247, a cheque to Jubilee Health Insurance Ltd, or a deposit to its bank account. Keep Jubilee's receipt.

Please note. This is a quotation, not cover: cover starts when Jubilee accepts the application and receives the full premium. Declare all health conditions: an undeclared one can lead to refused claims or cancelled cover. This is a summary; Jubilee's policy document prevails.
